## CLR normalization of ADT
```{r CLR}
# 2) Re-run CLR to a new layer for inspection (non-destructive)
T8 <- NormalizeData(
  T8,
  assay = "ADT",
  normalization.method = "CLR",
  margin = 2
)
```



## Figure 5A1 - MA plot route 1 vs route 2 DEGs (RNAseq)
```{r, MA plot}
DefaultAssay(T8) <- "RNA"
Idents(T8) <- "CD8.Cell.Types"
ident1 <- c("Tearly act(1)", "Teff(1)")  # Replace with your cluster IDs
ident2 <- c("Tearly act(2)", "Teff(2)")  # Replace with your cluster IDs

# 1) Get markers with log2 fold change (M)
## install presto devtools::install_github('immunogenomics/presto') for a more efficient implementation of wilcoxon rank sum test
r1v2 <- FindMarkers(T8, 
                    ident.1 = c("Tearly act(1)", "Teff(1)"),
                    ident.2 = c("Tearly act(2)", "Teff(2)"), 
                    min.pct = 0.25, 
                    assay = 'RNA')

# Detect logFC column name across Seurat versions
lfc_col <- if ("avg_log2FC" %in% colnames(r1v2)) "avg_log2FC" else "avg_logFC"

# Add gene names column for downstream merges/labels
r1v2$gene <- rownames(r1v2)

# 2) Build combined cell sets
cells_g1 <- WhichCells(T8, idents = ident1)
cells_g2 <- WhichCells(T8, idents = ident2)
stopifnot(length(cells_g1) > 0, length(cells_g2) > 0)

# 3) Get RNA transformed matrix (log1p-normalized in the 'data' layer in typical workflows)
mat_data <- GetAssayData(T8, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

# 4) Group-wise means across cells (rowMeans)
mu_g1 <- Matrix::rowMeans(mat_data[, cells_g1, drop = FALSE])
mu_g2 <- Matrix::rowMeans(mat_data[, cells_g2, drop = FALSE])

# 5) Assemble A (average of group means on the log1p scale) and merge with M
A_df <- data.frame(gene = names(mu_g1), A = 0.5 * (mu_g1 + mu_g2))
ma_df <- r1v2 %>%
  select(gene, M = all_of(lfc_col), p_val, p_val_adj) %>%
  inner_join(A_df, by = "gene")

# 6) Significance and single categorical color assignment
# Typical RNA thresholds; tweak to taste
fc_thresh <- 0.6   # e.g., |log2FC| >= 1
padj_thresh <- 0.05

ma_df <- ma_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig = p_val_adj < padj_thresh & abs(M) >= fc_thresh,
    color_group = case_when(
      sig & M > 0 ~ "ident1_sig",   # significant and up in ident1
      sig & M < 0 ~ "ident2_sig",   # significant and up in ident2
      TRUE        ~ "non_sig"       # all non-significant
    )
  )


# 7) Choose which significant features to label
# Label all significant features (you can cap per group if needed)
# Optional: cap labels per group (uncomment if plot is too busy)
label_df <- bind_rows(
   ma_df %>% filter(color_group == "ident1_sig") %>% arrange(desc(abs(M))) %>% dplyr::slice(1:15),
   ma_df %>% filter(color_group == "ident2_sig") %>% arrange(desc(abs(M))) %>% dplyr::slice(1:15)
)

# 8) Define colors: green for ident1_sig, orange for ident2_sig, grey for non_sig
cols <- c(
  ident1_sig = "#ED7953FF",  # green
  ident2_sig = "darkgreen",  # orange
  non_sig    = "grey70"    # grey
)

ggplot(ma_df, aes(x = A, y = M)) +
  # Points colored by single categorical scheme
  geom_point(aes(color = color_group), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
#  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  # Labels colored by the same categorical scheme
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = gene, color = color_group),
    size = 4,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cols,
    breaks = c("ident1_sig", "ident2_sig", "non_sig"),
    labels = c("Up in route 1", "Up in route 2", "Non-significant"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("RNA MA Plot: ", paste(ident1, collapse = "+"), " vs ", paste(ident2, collapse = "+")),
    x = "A (Average RNA expression across routes)", #, log1p scale)",
    y = paste0("M (", lfc_col, ") ") #from FindMarkers, RNA)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-4, 4))


```

## Figure 5A2 - MA plot route 1 vs route 2 DEPs (CITEseq)
```{r, MA plot}
Idents(T8) <- "CD8.Cell.Types"
ident1 <- c("Tearly act(1)", "Teff(1)")  # Replace with your cluster IDs
ident2 <- c("Tearly act(2)", "Teff(2)")  # Replace with your cluster IDs

# 1) Get markers with log2 fold change (M)
r1v2 <- FindMarkers(T8, 
                    ident.1 = c("Tearly act(1)", "Teff(1)"),
                    ident.2 = c("Tearly act(2)", "Teff(2)"), 
                    min.pct = 0.25, 
                    assay = 'ADT')

# Detect logFC column name across Seurat versions
lfc_col <- if ("avg_log2FC" %in% colnames(r1v2)) "avg_log2FC" else "avg_logFC"

# Add feature names column for downstream merges/labels
r1v2$feature <- rownames(r1v2)

# 2) Build combined cell sets
cells_g1 <- WhichCells(T8, idents = ident1)
cells_g2 <- WhichCells(T8, idents = ident2)
stopifnot(length(cells_g1) > 0, length(cells_g2) > 0)

# 3) Get ADT transformed matrix (CLR-normalized in `data` slot)
mat_data <- GetAssayData(T8, assay = "ADT")

# 4) Group-wise means across cells (rowMeans)
mu_g1 <- Matrix::rowMeans(mat_data[, cells_g1, drop = FALSE])
mu_g2 <- Matrix::rowMeans(mat_data[, cells_g2, drop = FALSE])

# 5) Assemble A and merge with M
A_df <- data.frame(feature = names(mu_g1), A = 0.5 * (mu_g1 + mu_g2))

ma_df <- r1v2 %>%
  select(feature, M = all_of(lfc_col), p_val, p_val_adj) %>%
  inner_join(A_df, by = "feature")

# 6) Significance and single categorical color assignment
# Adjust thresholds to your data; ADT often benefits from smaller FC thresholds (e.g., 0.25–0.5)
fc_thresh <- 0.25
ma_df <- ma_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig = p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(M) >= fc_thresh,
    color_group = case_when(
      sig & M > 0 ~ "ident1_sig",   # significant and up in ident1
      sig & M < 0 ~ "ident2_sig",   # significant and up in ident2
      TRUE        ~ "non_sig"       # all non-significant, regardless of M
    )
  )

# 7) Choose which significant features to label
# Label all significant features (you can cap per group if needed)
label_df <- ma_df %>% filter(color_group != "non_sig")

# Optional: cap labels per group (uncomment if plot is too busy)
# label_df <- bind_rows(
#   ma_df %>% filter(color_group == "ident1_sig") %>% arrange(desc(abs(M))) %>% slice(15),
#   ma_df %>% filter(color_group == "ident2_sig") %>% arrange(desc(abs(M))) %>% slice(15)
# )

# 8) Define colors: green for ident1_sig, orange for ident2_sig, grey for non_sig
cols <- c(
  ident1_sig = "#ED7953FF",  # green
  ident2_sig = "darkgreen",  # orange
  non_sig    = "grey70"    # grey
)

ggplot(ma_df, aes(x = A, y = M)) +
  # Points colored by single categorical scheme
  geom_point(aes(color = color_group), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0, col = "gray", linetype = 'dashed') +
  # Labels colored by the same categorical scheme
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = feature, color = color_group),
    size = 4,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cols,
    breaks = c("ident1_sig", "ident2_sig", "non_sig"),
    labels = c("Up in route 1", "Up in route 2", "Non-significant"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("ADT MA Plot: ", paste(ident1, collapse = "+"), " vs ", paste(ident2, collapse = "+")),
    x = "A (Average ADT expression across routes)", ## combined groups, CLR scale)",
    y = paste0("M (",lfc_col,")")  # from FindMarkers, ADT
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5))

## NB. cut-off log2FC is >0.25 here
```


## Figure 5B - heatmap selected genes route 1 vs route 2 clusters
```{r}

# subset route 1 and route 2 clusters
T8routes <- subset(T8, idents = c("Tearly act(1)", "Teff(1)","Tearly act(2)", "Teff(2)"))
T8routes$CD8.Cell.Types <- factor(mapvalues(T8routes$CD8.Cell.Types,
                                      from = c("Tearly act(1)" , "Tearly act(2)", "Teff(1)"  ,"Teff(2)"),
                                           
                                      to = c("Tearly act(1)" , "Tearly act(2)", "Teff(1)"  ,"Teff(2)")),
                            levels = c("Tearly act(1)", "Teff(1)","Tearly act(2)", "Teff(2)")
)

## selection of DEGs specific for route 1 or route 2 clustes, or more early act or eff genes
genes <- c("ZNF683", "LTB", "CISH",  "CXCR3","KLRC1", "KLRD1", "XCL1", "HOPX", "ITGAE","IL7R",
           "NFKBIA", "NFKBIZ", "TNFAIP3", "ANXA1", 
           "KLRG1", "EOMES", "PLEK", "NKG7", "HLA-DPA1", "GZMA", "CMC1", 
           "GZMK", "TNFSF9", "KLF2", "CXCR4", "CCL4")



# Single cell heatmap of feature expression
T8routes <- ScaleData(T8routes, features = genes)

# Calculate average expression per cluster
avg_expr <- AggregateExpression(object = T8routes, group.by = "CD8.Cell.Types") 
#avg_expr <- AggregateExpression(object = T8, group.by = "CD8.Cell.Types")

# Extract the expression matrix
avg_expr_matrix <- avg_expr$RNA

# Extract normalized counts for the genes of interest
normalized_counts <- T8routes@assays$RNA@counts[rownames(T8routes@assays$RNA@counts) %in% genes, ]

# subset_matrix contains the expression values for allgenes per cluster
subset_matrix <- avg_expr_matrix[rownames(avg_expr_matrix) %in% genes, ]

# order rows
row_names <- rownames(avg_expr_matrix)

# Determine order based on 'genes'
ordered_indices <- order(match(row_names, genes))

# Reassign ordered row names
subset_matrix <- avg_expr_matrix[ordered_indices, ]
subset_matrix <- subset_matrix[rownames(subset_matrix) %in% genes, ]

### scale with z-score
cal_z_score <- function(x){
  (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}

data_subset_norm <- t(apply(subset_matrix, 1, cal_z_score))

# create heatmap
pheatmap(data_subset_norm,
         #color = hcl.colors(50, "RdGy", rev = T),
         #order_color = NA,
         cutree_rows = F,
         cellwidth = 18,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         main = "route 1 vs. route 2")


```
